The third section is SURFACEWORKS, NCPA CONTRACT# 07-46. Line 65 is a Dewey 6-top table, 29" height (RLNT6TOPCB), at 1,154.88, with laminate top surface, solid urethane edge Hippo U22, Charcoal P09 base finish, three locking and three non-locking casters, no grommet and no power, referencing quote QSW21_054738-2 under tag H1. The proposal summary block shows SUBTOTAL 46,031.40, DEPOSIT REQUIRED 25,400.00, FREIGHT 1,300.00, INSTALL 3,525.00, and TOTAL 50,856.40, with signature lines for ACCEPTED BY and DATE ACCEPTED. The document runs 8 pages of line items plus panel elevation notes listing panel sizes such as 42.5Hx60W and 50Hx24W (qty 2 each), 3'1.5"H, 3'6.5", 5'0", 3'9"H, 4'2" and 2'0", with Spin04 fabric and Allsteel Terrace panel tags for D3 (key 101) and D4 (key 102, 3 key cores).

The attached Terms and Conditions of Sale set out that all prices quoted by Interior Environments are valid for 30 days from the date of proposal; that the seller's proposal constitutes an offer and the buyer's approval constitutes acceptance; that all goods are custom manufactured and cannot be returned, with no restocking programs; and that modifications require a signed and dated revised proposal. All orders are subject to credit approval, with a deposit of 50% required on all orders greater than $5,000.00 and orders less than $5,000.00 payable in full. Title transfers when the agreement is entered. Invoices are due on the date noted, with a monthly service charge of 1.5% (18% A.P.R.) on unpaid balances and a 3% service charge added to invoices paid by credit card. Freight is FOB origin and the buyer is responsible for applicable sales, use and excise taxes unless tax-exempt documentation is provided before order placement. Contracted delivery and installation occur during normal business hours of 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., Monday through Friday, with time-and-a-half for weekday overtime and double time for weekends and holidays. Buyers must report concealed or damaged packaged goods within seven (7) business days of receipt and damage revealed upon unpackaging within seven (7) days, with photographs required for warranty claims. The seller disclaims all express and implied warranties, including merchantability and fitness for a particular purpose, while preserving buyer rights against manufacturers. Default remedies apply if the buyer fails to pay within ten (10) days after an amount is due. Any action by the buyer must be brought within one year after the cause of action accrues. The agreement is deemed entered into and performed in substantial part in Oakland County, Michigan, is governed by Michigan law, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of state or federal courts serving Oakland County, Michigan.
